Pioneering Embodied Intelligence

The Embodied Intelligence and Robotics (EMBR) Lab at UC Berkeley explores the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and embodied intelligence. We develop systems that can perceive, reason, and act in complex physical environments through embodied learning.

Our research spans robotics, computer vision, reinforcement learning, and human-robot interaction with applications in healthcare, manufacturing, and everyday assistance.

45+ Publications

Research Areas

🤖

Robotic Learning

Developing algorithms that enable robots to learn complex skills through interaction and demonstration.

👁️

Visual Perception

Creating systems that understand visual environments for effective navigation and manipulation.

🧠

Embodied AI

Building agents that develop intelligence through physical interaction with their environment.

🤝

Human-Robot Collaboration

Designing interfaces and interaction protocols for seamless human-robot teamwork.
